manifest.scope: Investigation only; new export is evidence for filling the Raxx-derived base, not a filter policy to transplant.
manifest.screenshot_transcription: Affix IDs matched to frozen names after viewing both user images. Numbers preserve displayed order; no ring priorities are shown.

mechanism_sources.supports: Heretical idols have normal affixes plus separate enchanted affixes; enchanting can be rerolled.
Experimental item crafting replaces a prefix; experimental affixes can obtain exalted tiers using Rune of Havoc.

strict.name: Skeleton Necromancer
strict.description: BinaQc's Strict - Recommended for start of Empowered Monolith. Hides most Uniques without significant LP/WW. Hides most Rares. Hides Set Items.

very_strict.name: Skeleton Necromancer
very_strict.description: BinaQc's Very Strict - Recommended to focus on Tier 7 Items. High LP Uniques. Hides most Tier 6 Exalteds. Shows best Exalted Bases. Hides Sets.
